reviews.use_summary: Maps 10x SPN nuclei onto the mouse whole-brain taxonomy using Hierarchical Approximate Nearest Neighbour mapping in scrattch-mapping; calculates correspondence confusion matrices at cluster, supertype and subclass levels and summarizes marker correlations.
uncertainties: Package edition, exact function, marker list, distance metric and complete caller options are unreported.
Do not borrow P059 edition 0.2 or conflate this mapping with BIGCAT i_harmonize.

reviews.use_summary: Assigns query cells hierarchically through a root/class/subclass/cluster tree. At each internal node, markers discriminate child-node clusters and cells follow the nearest cluster centroid until reaching leaf clusters; the paper also links this hierarchy to MapMyCells.

reported_settings.assignment: nearest cluster centroid using markers selected at each internal node

uncertainties: Exact function, distance metric, tie policy and all caller arguments are not reported.
BIGCAT map_cells_knn_big is a separately named package/function path and is not inferred to implement this hierarchy.
